versions.subject: Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'Cmd.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'mklink'
        - '\System32\osk.exe'
        - '\System32\cmd.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe" OR OriginalFileName="Cmd.exe" CommandLine="*mklink*" CommandLine="*\\System32\\osk.exe*" CommandLine="*\\System32\\cmd.exe*"
